# ==============================================================================
# TIMEX CERAMIC - PRODUCTION APACHE / CPANEL CONFIGURATION (.htaccess)
# ==============================================================================
# Note: When hosted on Netlify, routing is controlled by netlify.toml & _redirects.
# This file applies when hosting on Apache 2.4+ / LiteSpeed web servers.
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Enable Rewrite Engine & Force HTTPS
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
  RewriteEngine On
  RewriteBase /

  # Redirect HTTP to HTTPS
  RewriteCond %{HTTPS} off
  RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]

  # Remove trailing slashes (except directories)
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
  RewriteRule ^(.*)/$ /$1 [L,R=301]

  # Clean URLs: Serve .html files without extension
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
  RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/$1.html -f
  RewriteRule ^([^/]+)/?$ $1.html [L]

  # SPA Fallback: Route unknown requests to index.html
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
  RewriteRule ^ index.html [L]
</IfModule>

# 2. Browser Caching & Performance
<IfModule mod_expires.c>
  ExpiresActive On
  ExpiresDefault "access plus 1 month"

  # HTML
  ExpiresByType text/html "access plus 0 seconds"

  # CSS & JavaScript
  ExpiresByType text/css "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType application/javascript "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType text/javascript "access plus 1 year"

  # Images & Media
  ExpiresByType image/webp "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType image/jpeg "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType image/png "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType image/svg+xml "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType image/x-icon "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType font/woff2 "access plus 1 year"
</IfModule>

# 3. Gzip / Deflate Compression
<IfModule mod_deflate.c>
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/plain text/xml text/css
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE application/javascript application/json application/xml
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE image/svg+xml
</IfModule>

# 4. Security Headers
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
  Header set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
  Header set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
  Header set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
  Header set Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()"
</IfModule>

# 5. Disable Directory Browsing
Options -Indexes

- [Brick Collection](https://www.timexceramic.com/collections/brick): Timeless rustic and industrial brick wall tiles.

faqs.question: 1. Where can I find brick wall tiles in Mumbai?
faqs.answer: You can explore brick wall tiles in Mumbai through Timex Ceramic's online brick tile collection. Review the available designs and contact the team to confirm product specifications, availability and suitability for your project.

faqs.question: 2. What are brick tiles?
faqs.answer: Brick tiles are tiles designed to reproduce the appearance of traditional brickwork. They may be crafted from ceramic, porcelain or other materials. Used to create brick-inspired finishes on suitable walls and, where approved, floors.

faqs.question: 3. What are the benefits of brick wall tiles?
faqs.answer: Brick wall tiles can introduce texture, visual warmth and architectural character without requiring a conventional exposed-brick wall. Their maintenance, durability and weather performance depend on the selected material, finish and installation quality.

faqs.question: 4. Are brick tiles suitable for exterior walls in Mumbai?
faqs.answer: Yes, certain brick-look tiles are suitable for exterior walls in Mumbai. Choose products rated for outdoor exposure and consider rainfall, moisture, temperature changes, substrate conditions and the recommended installation system.

faqs.question: 5. Which brick tiles are best for exterior building elevations?
faqs.answer: The best option is a tile specifically approved for exterior elevation use, with appropriate durability, water absorption characteristics and fixing compatibility. The selection should also account for the building's design, exposure conditions and maintenance requirements.

faqs.question: 6. Are brick cladding tiles suitable for residential buildings?
faqs.answer: Brick cladding tiles can be suitable for residential buildings when the chosen product and installation system are appropriate for the application. They can be used on selected façades, entrance walls, columns and other architectural features.

faqs.question: 7. What is the difference between brick tiles and traditional bricks?
faqs.answer: Traditional bricks are masonry units used in construction, while brick tiles are generally thinner decorative or finishing products designed to create a brick-like appearance. Their structural role, weight and installation method differ, so they should not be treated as interchangeable.

faqs.question: 8. Are brick tiles available in modern designs?
faqs.answer: Yes, brick-look tiles are available in styles ranging from rustic and vintage to minimalist and contemporary. Depending on the collection, design options may include muted neutrals, textured surfaces, dark colours and clean rectangular formats.

faqs.question: 9. Are black brick tiles suitable for modern interiors?
faqs.answer: Black brick tiles can create a striking feature wall in modern living rooms, cafés, retail spaces and industrial-inspired interiors. Pair them with lighter walls, warm wood or contrasting metal details to balance the visual effect.

faqs.question: 10. Can brick tiles be used in restaurants and cafés?
faqs.answer: Yes, suitable brick-look tiles can be used for restaurant feature walls, café interiors, reception areas and selected exterior surfaces. Choose materials and finishes that meet the project's cleaning, durability, fire-safety and application requirements.

faqs.question: 11. Are brick tiles suitable for kitchen backsplashes?
faqs.answer: Brick-look wall tiles can be suitable for kitchen backsplashes when the specific product is approved for the application. Consider resistance to stains, grease, moisture and cleaning products, along with appropriate grout and installation details.

faqs.question: 12. Can brick tiles be installed in bathrooms?
faqs.answer: Certain brick-look tiles are suitable for bathroom walls and selected wet-area applications. Check the manufacturer's recommendations for moisture exposure, cleaning, waterproofing and installation before selecting a product.

faqs.question: 13. Can brick tiles be used for flooring?
faqs.answer: Some brick-look tiles are designed for floor use, but not every brick tile is suitable for flooring. Confirm the product's floor-use rating, load requirements, wear resistance and slip performance before installation.

faqs.question: 14. Are porcelain brick tiles suitable for outdoor projects?
faqs.answer: Porcelain brick-look tiles can be suitable for some outdoor projects when their technical specifications and installation system meet the exposure conditions. For outdoor floors, also evaluate slip resistance, drainage and the intended traffic level.

faqs.question: 15. What finishes are available in brick tiles?
faqs.answer: Brick-look tiles may be available in matte, textured, rustic or glazed finishes, depending on the collection. Check the individual product details to confirm the actual finish and its recommended uses.

faqs.question: 16. Are small-format brick tiles suitable for feature walls?
faqs.answer: Yes, small-format brick tiles can create detailed patterns and emphasise the traditional appearance of brickwork. They can work well on accent walls, counters and selected architectural details.

faqs.question: 1. What are colourful ceramic tiles?
faqs.answer: Colourful ceramic tiles are tiles available in a range of shades, colour combinations, and decorative designs. They can be used to add contrast, create a focal point, or complement an interior's overall colour palette.

faqs.question: 2. Where can I find colourful tiles in Mumbai?
faqs.answer: You can explore the colourful tile collection on the Timex Ceramic website and contact the team for product information and help identifying options for your residential or commercial project.

faqs.question: 3. Where can colourful wall tiles be used?
faqs.answer: Colourful wall tiles can be used in suitable kitchen backsplash areas, bathroom walls, living room features, decorative niches, entrance areas, and selected commercial interiors. Always check the product's intended application.

faqs.question: 4. Are colourful tiles suitable for kitchen walls?
faqs.answer: Yes, suitable colourful tiles can be used on kitchen walls and backsplashes. Consider how easily the surface can be cleaned and whether the finish suits areas exposed to oil, food splashes, and frequent use.

faqs.question: 5. Can colourful tiles be used in bathrooms?
faqs.answer: Yes, colourful tiles can add character to bathroom walls, vanity backdrops, and other suitable surfaces. For wet areas and bathroom floors, verify the product's suitability and relevant slip-resistance specifications.

faqs.question: 6. Are colourful floor tiles suitable for living rooms?
faqs.answer: Selected colourful floor tiles can be used in living rooms when the product is rated for flooring and meets the space's performance requirements. Consider the overall colour scheme, foot traffic, maintenance, and surface finish.

faqs.question: 7. What are multicolour tiles?
faqs.answer: Multicolour tiles feature two or more colours within a design, pattern, or coordinated collection. They can create a playful, decorative, artistic, or contemporary effect depending on the shades and layout.

faqs.question: 8. How do I choose colourful tiles for a small room?
faqs.answer: Consider using a limited colour palette, a restrained pattern, or a single accent area. Review the tile alongside the room's lighting and other finishes to ensure that the overall design feels balanced.

faqs.question: 9. How can I coordinate colourful tiles with furniture and cabinets?
faqs.answer: Choose one or two colours that complement the existing materials, then use neutral finishes or supporting shades to maintain balance. Reviewing physical samples alongside cabinetry, countertops, flooring, and furniture can help.

faqs.question: 10. Are colourful tiles suitable for hotels, cafés, and commercial projects?
faqs.answer: Suitable colourful tiles can be specified for selected hospitality, retail, restaurant, and office interiors. Project teams should verify the intended application, maintenance needs, and performance specifications for the proposed installation.

faqs.question: 11. What should architects and interior designers consider before specifying colourful tiles?
faqs.answer: Consider the design concept, colour palette, dimensions, layout, grout selection, lighting, installation requirements, maintenance, and intended application. For larger projects, confirm product details and availability before finalising specifications.

faqs.question: 12. How do I maintain colourful ceramic tiles?
faqs.answer: Maintenance depends on the tile material and finish. Use cleaning products and methods recommended for the specific tile, clean spills promptly where appropriate, and avoid harsh chemicals unless the manufacturer confirms they are suitable.
